zh.title: Iberojet計畫9月起開航巴塞隆納與馬德里至薩爾瓦多航線
zh.summary: 西班牙航商Iberojet預計於2026年9月起開航往返薩爾瓦多的定期航班
body: 根據AeroTime報導，西班牙航空品牌Iberojet正準備在其航網中增加新航點，預計將自2026年9月起，開航從巴塞隆納（BCN）與馬德里（MAD）往返薩爾瓦多（SAL）的定期航班。
該公司目前採用混合商業模式，其定期與包機業務約佔總業務的百分之七十，其餘的百分之三十則由ACMI（飛機、機組、維修及保險）業務組成。截至2026年8月，Iberojet營運著一支全空中巴士機隊，共計有7架飛機，其中包括兩架A350-900、兩架A330-900neo、一架A330-300，以及一架空中巴士A320（ICAO機型代碼A320）。

en.title: Iberojet to Launch New Scheduled Flights to El Salvador from Barcelona and Madrid
en.summary: Iberojet plans to launch new scheduled flights to El Salvador starting in September 2026.
body: Spanish carrier Iberojet plans to add new destinations to its network, including scheduled flights to El Salvador (SAL). According to the aviation news outlet AeroTime, these flights will be operated from both Barcelona (BCN) and Madrid (MAD) starting in September 2026.

The airline operates a hybrid business model where scheduled and charter operations represent approximately 70 percent of its business, while the ACMI segment generates the remaining 30 percent. As of August 2026, Iberojet operates an all-Airbus fleet of seven aircraft, including two A350-900s, two A330-900neos, one A330-300, and one Airbus A320 (ICAO type code A320).

zh.title: REGENT完成Viceroy載人地效翼水上飛機首次試飛
zh.summary: REGENT在羅德島州完成Viceroy地效翼水上飛機首次載人試飛；飛行30秒
body: 水上飛機製造商REGENT於2026年9月2日宣佈，已成功完成旗下Viceroy地效翼水上飛機的首次載人飛行測試。根據AeroTime報導，本次試飛地點位於REGENT總部所在地美國羅德島州的納拉甘西特灣（Narragansett Bay），標誌著該款純電動客運載具邁入新的測試階段。
在本次於納拉甘西特灣進行的試飛過程中，Viceroy地效翼水上飛機共搭載2名機組人員。該載具在水面上方33英呎（約10公尺）的高度飛行了30秒，飛行距離達到1,956英呎（約596公尺）。在此次載人試飛之前，REGENT已對Viceroy進行了船體水上測試與水翼（hydrofoils）測試。水翼能在風浪較大的海況下提供穩定性，並在載具加速時協助過渡至完全飛行的狀態。
Viceroy採用全電動動力系統，利用稱為「地面效應」（ground effect）的氣動力學原理，設計載客量高達12名乘客，能在海面上方以高達每小時180英里（約289公里）的速度掠海飛行。隨著此次試飛完成，Viceroy成為載人飛行的最大型全電動地面效應載具。相較之下，蘇聯於1970年代運行的大型載人實驗性地效翼載具（即地效飛行器）則採用傳統動力，且專用於軍事用途。
在此次載人試飛完成的前兩天，REGENT才剛宣佈完成金額達2.4億美元的B輪融資，相關資金將用於加速其地效翼水上飛機計劃的開發進程。此外，REGENT亦於2026年期間，針對名為Squire的較小型無人地效翼載具進行了飛行測試，該載具主要設計應用於軍事領域。

en.title: REGENT Completes First Human-Crewed Flight of Viceroy Seaglider
en.summary: REGENT completes the first human-crewed flight test of its Viceroy ground-effect seaglider in Rhode Island.
body: Seaglider developer REGENT announced on September 2, 2026, that it has successfully completed the first human-crewed flight test of its Viceroy wing-in-ground effect craft. According to reporting by AeroTime, the inaugural flight test was conducted over Narragansett Bay in Rhode Island, where REGENT is headquartered, representing a significant technical operational step for the electric passenger craft program.

During the milestone flight test on Narragansett Bay, the Viceroy seaglider operated with a crew of two individuals on board. The craft sustained flight above the water for 30 seconds, traversing a total distance of 1,956 feet (596 meters) while maintaining an elevation of 33 feet (10 meters) above the sea surface. Prior to achieving this human-crewed flight, REGENT had engaged in preliminary testing, evaluating the vehicle with its hull directly on the water as well as on hydrofoil fins designed to provide stability in choppy sea conditions and support the transition to full aerodynamic ground-effect flight as the vehicle accelerates.

The Viceroy is designed as an all-electric craft capable of accommodating up to 12 passengers while skimming over the ocean surface at speed up to 180 mph (289 km/h). The craft utilizes an aerodynamic principle known as ground effect to operate close to the water. With the successful completion of this test, the Viceroy becomes the largest all-electric wing-in-ground-effect vehicle to fly with human occupants on board. Larger historical crewed wing-in-ground craft, such as Soviet ekranoplans from the 1970s, relied on conventional military propulsion rather than electric power.

The successful test flight follows additional corporate and program milestones for REGENT. Just two days prior to completing the crewed flight, the company announced the successful closing of a $240 million Series B funding round dedicated to accelerating the development of its broader wing-in-ground seaglider program. In addition to the Viceroy development, REGENT has also conducted flight tests in 2026 for Squire, a smaller uncrewed wing-in-ground effect vehicle designed for potential military applications.

zh.title: 美擬因伊朗關聯制裁航空公司與飛機租賃商
zh.summary: 美國財政部考慮制裁與伊朗有聯繫的航空公司與飛機租賃公司。
body: 根據《AeroTime》報導，美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）於2026年9月2日表示，航空公司可能成為華府針對伊朗經濟制裁行動的新目標。貝森特在前一日亦指出，飛機租賃公司正處於審查階段，任何與伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊（IRGC）開展業務往來的實體均可能面臨制裁。
此前，美國財政部外國資產控制辦公室（OFAC）已於2026年8月24日依據第13902號行政命令，發布了五項行業認定。此舉為「經濟邊緣人行動」（Operation Economic Outcast）的一部分，範圍涵蓋伊朗的航空、航運、數位資產、科技及黃金等領域，允許美方對在這些領域營運的任何個人或實體實施制裁。

en.title: US Considers Sanctions on Airlines and Aircraft Lessors Over Iran Ties
en.summary: US Treasury warns of potential sanctions on airlines and leasing companies over Iran ties.
body: According to AeroTime, US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent stated on September 2, 2026, that commercial airlines and aircraft leasing companies could become targets of Washington’s ongoing economic campaign against Iran. Bessent noted that potential sanctions could apply to any entity doing business with the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC).

This warning follows sectoral determinations issued by the Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) on August 24, 2026. Under Executive Order 13902, these determinations target Iran's aviation, shipping, technology, digital assets, and gold sectors, enabling the US government to sanction participating entities regardless of their location.

zh.title: 美國FAA完成第100座塔台地面意識系統部署 涵蓋近半預定機場
zh.summary: FAA完成第100座塔台地面意識系統部署；2026年底前預計再擴增44座機場。
body: 美國運輸部長肖恩·杜菲（Sean P. Duffy）於2026年9月2日宣布，美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）已完成第100座飛航管制塔台的地面意識倡議（Surface Awareness Initiative，簡稱SAI）系統部署。該系統為一款針對地面航空器與車輛的監控工具，本次部署完成標誌著該計畫邁入新里程碑，目前已覆蓋預計接收該系統的220座機場中接近一半的數量。
SAI系統旨在提升跑道運作效率，並協助飛航管制員確保航空地面作業安全。該技術主要利用來自航空器與車輛的廣播式自動監視（ADS-B）數據，使管制員能夠即時掌握機場地面的交通狀況。即使在惡劣天氣條件下或航空器處於管制塔台視線死角時，管制員仍可透過該系統進行實時動態追蹤。

目前SAI系統已在全美100座飛航管制塔台投入運作。近期完成安裝營運的機場包括安阿伯市立機場（Ann Arbor Municipal Airport（ARB））、比靈斯-洛根國際機場（Billings-Logan International Airport（BIL））、海港-比洛克西國際機場（Gulfport-Biloxi International Airport（GPT））、格林維爾-斯帕坦堡國際機場（Greenville-Spartanburg International Airport（GSP））以及科珀斯克里斯蒂國際機場（Corpus Christi International Airport（CRP））。FAA計畫在2026年底前，繼續將該系統擴展安裝至另外44座機場。
除了SAI系統之外，FAA亦持續在全美各地機場與飛航設施推護其他具備靈活度與成本效益的跑道監控技術。其中，進場跑道確認系統（Approach Runway Verification）的部署速度已提升至原本的三倍，目前已在超過260處飛航設施上線運作；跑道入侵警示裝置（Runway Incursion Device）則已在全美超過56座飛航管制塔台投入使用。

en.title: FAA Deploys Surface Awareness Initiative System to 100th Airport Control Tower
en.summary: The FAA has installed its 100th Surface Awareness Initiative system, targeting 44 more airports by late 2026.
body: U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy announced on September 2, 2026, that the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has completed the installation of its 100th Surface Awareness Initiative (SAI) tool at air traffic control towers. SAI is a surveillance system designed for aircraft and vehicles on the ground. This deployment marks a key milestone in the agency's air traffic control overhaul, covering nearly half of the 220 airports slated to receive the technology.

The SAI tool is engineered to enhance runway efficiency and support air traffic controllers in maintaining operational safety. Utilizing Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast (ADS-B) data transmitted from aircraft and ground vehicles, the system enables controllers to monitor surface movement in real time. This capability assists controllers during adverse weather conditions or when aircraft are positioned out of direct line of sight from the control tower.

SAI is now operational at 100 control towers across the nation. Among the most recent installations are Ann Arbor Municipal Airport (ARB), Billings-Logan International Airport (BIL), Gulfport-Biloxi International Airport (GPT), Greenville-Spartanburg International Airport (GSP), and Corpus Christi International Airport (CRP). The FAA plans to expand the installation of SAI to an additional 44 airports by the end of 2026.

In addition to the SAI rollout, the FAA is continuing the deployment of other agile and cost-effective surface surveillance systems across national air traffic facilities. The agency has tripled the deployment speed of Approach Runway Verification technology, which is now operational at more than 260 air traffic facilities. Additionally, the Runway Incursion Device is currently active at more than 56 air traffic control towers.
